brief.audience: Independent hair salons that need an editorial, service-led site with clear consultation and appointment inquiry expectations
brief.primaryAction: Understand service fit and send an appointment inquiry; availability and message delivery remain explicitly unconfigured
brief.content: Fictional Morrow & Muse salon. The site uses natural salon marketing copy without invented reviews, prices, credentials, awards, years in business or performance claims. Team identities are fictional and labeled. Inquiry delivery is unconfigured and does not confirm an appointment.
brief.imagery: Original AI-generated editorial salon interior, texture-focused craft detail and fictional team scene in warm ivory, deep plum, dusty rose and stainless steel; original vector logo.

directions.thesis: A fashion-editorial salon identity where a deep plum copy panel cuts into a wide architectural photograph and service information reads like a precise studio ledger.

fingerprint.header: warm white masthead with interlaced plum mark
fingerprint.hero: wide salon room with overlapping lower-left plum copy panel
fingerprint.textAnchor: large serif statements paired with compact uppercase labels
fingerprint.inventory: open three-column service ledger without prices
fingerprint.footer: compact plum brand row with one wrapping link group

directions.comparison: Authored as the current local draft because it separates the salon identity from recent green split-hero templates and supports honest service detail. Awaiting human selection and rendered review.

sections.purpose: Introduce a premium but approachable salon point of view
sections.composition: full-width room image with an overlapping lower-edge copy block rather than a side-by-side split
sections.typography: high-contrast editorial serif with restrained sans labels
sections.imagery: warm salon architecture with plum lacquer and translucent curtains

sections.purpose: Make services scannable without inventing prices
sections.composition: service, scope and consultation note arranged in ruled rows
sections.typography: serif service names with plain-language descriptions

directions.thesis: A quieter monochrome direction organized as annotations around mirror views, material details and concise service notes.

fingerprint.hero: framed mirror reflection with caption below
fingerprint.textAnchor: small notes on a generous ivory field
fingerprint.inventory: service chapters with short care notes

directions.comparison: More restrained and object-led than Plum Cutout; retained as an unselected fingerprint only.

sections.purpose: Frame the studio through material detail
sections.composition: single framed image followed by editorial caption and statement
sections.typography: narrow sans labels with serif body statements

sections.composition: long-form service groups separated by rules

directions.thesis: A team-led documentary direction that opens backstage and follows the rhythm from setup to consultation and finish.

fingerprint.header: dark plum bar with reverse symbol
fingerprint.hero: wide team-preparation scene with bottom caption

directions.comparison: More human and process-led than Plum Cutout; retained as an unselected fingerprint only.

sections.purpose: Show the studio before client service begins

sections.typography: documentary sans with one oversized serif line

sections.purpose: Describe what an appointment makes room for
sections.composition: three plain-language stages separated by rules without decorative counters

findings.detail: The appointment inquiry form intentionally has no delivery action and remains disabled in published output until an owner configures it.
findings.correction: Configure and test an approved recipient or booking provider, then update inquiry and confirmation wording before release.
